verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes simultaneous battery charging and operation plus required 3.3V and 5V power rails for the integrated-board power architecture.
The client adds battery efficiency and maximum operating time as an electrical-design acceptance goal; no obsolete value key requires removal.
The client explicitly leaves the power-management component choice unresolved between AXP2101 and a simpler alternative capable of simultaneous charging and operation.
The client selects the existing AXP2101 as the integrated board's power-management component; no prior provider attribute must be removed.
The client resolves the material component-choice uncertainty, returning the power-management architecture to active implementation.
